decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The windows proposed on any side elevation of the extension(s) hereby permitted and any other windows on the side elevation of the host dwellinghouse associated with the works shall:

(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,

(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site Location Plan; Drawing numbers SC 25005 - KLEX 01, SC 25005 - KLEX 02, SC 25005 - KLEX 03, SC 25005 - KLPP 01, SC 25005 - KLPP 02, SC 25005 - KLPP 03, and SC 25005 - KLPP 04.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed on side elevations of the of the development hereby permitted, without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension/s hereby permitted shall match those (including colour) used in the existing building only, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a First floor rear extension and external alterations
